summary: EVAVO's governed editable-vector, raster reconstruction, SVG delivery, print preflight, animated SVG, Lottie/dotLottie, resumable batch and local worker authority. It exposes bounded CLI/MCP/automation production surfaces with create-only outputs and explicit review boundaries; it does not grant creative approval, Git publication or release authority.

capabilities.title: Inspect raster and SVG source safely
capabilities.description: Inspect admitted static raster or SVG inputs for source identity, visible bounds, alpha-aware content, active-content risks, geometry, topology and editability without modifying the source.
requires: Static supported raster or governed SVG

capabilities.title: Trace raster art into governed editable SVG
capabilities.description: Trace one admitted static raster into a new editable, web, motion or print SVG with alpha-aware candidate analysis, stable IDs where required, optional difference evidence and no existing-file overwrite.
requires: New output path inside allowed root
Human or governed design review before production approval

capabilities.title: Inspect and package governed SVG delivery assets
capabilities.description: Inspect and conservatively package an existing governed SVG for editable, web, motion or print delivery with stable IDs, responsive root handling, safety rollback evidence and create-only output behavior.

capabilities.title: Run bounded SVG print preflight
capabilities.description: Inspect one admitted SVG against governed print-production constraints for commercial, large-format, cut-vinyl or screen-print intent without writing a file or claiming physical-production approval.
requires: Separate physical proof and production approval

capabilities.title: Validate and author governed animated SVG
capabilities.description: Validate an EVAVO motion plan and apply it to governed SVG targets using script-free CSS keyframes, stable target IDs and reduced-motion fallback with optional evidence output.

capabilities.title: Export governed Lottie and dotLottie animation
capabilities.description: Export the supported path-based SVG/motion subset to deterministic Lottie JSON and package or inspect deterministic dotLottie archives without returning generated bodies or archive bytes to model context.

capabilities.title: Run resumable bounded vector production batches
capabilities.description: Run or inspect bounded batch-v1 manifests through persistent local state, immutable input revisions, receipt-verified output reuse and create-only transactions. Batches resume when invoked again and are not a hosted background queue.
requires: At most configured batch item ceiling

capabilities.title: Execute governed local vector worker jobs
capabilities.description: Import immutable objects, submit/inspect/cancel jobs and execute supported vector operations through the local worker or HTTP-coordinated worker with leases, retries, cancellation and output receipts. Managed distributed execution is not claimed.
requires: No implicit Git or release authority

capabilities.title: Serve bounded Vector Studio MCP tools
capabilities.description: Serve the Vector Studio MCP 1.6 contract for capability discovery, input policy, raster/SVG inspection, tracing, packaging, print, motion, Lottie/dotLottie and durable batch operations beneath configured allowed roots.

capabilities.title: Run complete Vector Studio validation
capabilities.description: Run repository contract, capability discovery, hygiene, API, MCP, motion, Lottie, batch, worker, lint, type, test and build checks without granting output approval or publication authority.

topics: SVG safety, geometry, topology and editability
creative review and production approval boundaries
